description: The AMS article class; preloads amsmath and amsthm. amsart's \@seccntformat ends in \protect\@secnumpunct, which amsart defines only inside its own \@sect (an \edef, '.\enspace' for a titled head; amsclass.dtx). titlesec sets every level it has no \titleformat for with that label but not through \@sect (titlesec.sty \ttl@@extract, separator zero), so each numbered heading at such a level stopped at 'Undefined control sequence \@secnumpunct' (batch 3b: 54 amsart.A and 53 amsart.B documents, every one holding a titlesec way; num.appendix's own \section among them). The preamble provides amsart's own '.\enspace'; amsart's \@sect still sets it again before each of its own headings, so a document without titlesec typesets as before. A second line (b23 PG-3, from GitHub run r2-461ed0e) makes TeX count the footnote rule's height in a document that loads multicol: amsart's \footnoterule (amsart.cls l.1310-1311: \kern-.4pt, a 0.4pt rule, \kern11pt, \kern-\footnotesep, with \footnotesep the height of a footnotesize 'M$^1$', l.236) takes 4.31pt, where LaTeX's convention, which TeX's page builder and multicol's column height (\leave@mult@footins, multicol.sty l.500-503: \skip\footins and the notes' height only) both rely on, is a rule that takes none. multicol fills its columns to the exact height, so every page it made with a footnote ran 4.31pt past the text block ('Overfull \vbox (4.31001pt too high) has occurred while \output is active'): a document problem in 33 amsart.A and amsart.B cells (1,784 not-denied rows) and a branch's own in 55 (202 rows), every one holding multicol and a footnote; 1,377 rows failed on nothing else. At \begin{document} the line measures the rule, adds its height to \skip\footins and starts the rule with a kern of the same amount back up, so the rule and the notes print where they did, and the page builder and multicol leave the room they take (GitHub probe b23-1, db9e9d2f38a9263a2d4c6: the 13 such overflows in amsart.A and 11 in amsart.B gone, no other amount changed but one: a multicols* column already too full beside its notes is too full by the rule's height more, 7.90pt to 12.21pt, as it is with any rule of no net height). A document without multicol keeps both as the class sets them.
